data.additional_information:
Job Description: PhD Intern - Formal Methods Research
Location: India Program: Student Researcher Program Position Type: Paid Internship
About the Role:
Alstom invites applications for a PhD Intern position in our Student Researcher Program, focusing on Formal Methods for verifying safety-critical systems. This role presents a unique opportunity to collaborate with Alstom’s research scientists and engineers in addressing challenges related to model checking and theorem proving.
Objectives:
· Model Checking: Develop and implement model checking algorithms to verify the correctness of safety-critical system designs against specified requirements.
· Theorem Proving: Utilize theorem proving techniques to establish the formal correctness of system properties, ensuring adherence to safety and operational standards.
· Formal Verification Framework: Contribute to the creation and enhancement of frameworks that integrate formal verification methods with existing development processes, improving the overall quality and reliability of our systems.
Problem Statement:
Ensuring the safety and reliability of critical systems is paramount in our projects. The current approaches to verification can be inefficient and may not capture all scenarios, leading to potential safety risks. By advancing the use of formal methods, we aim to enhance our verification processes and ensure our systems meet the highest safety standards.
Qualifications:
· Currently pursuing a PhD in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field.
· Knowledge and working experience in model checking and theorem proving concepts.
· Familiarity with formal verification tools and techniques.
· Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
Program Requirements:
· Participation in this program requires that you are in India for the duration of the engagement.
· This opportunity is best suited for students who do not seek full-time employment following this role, as this program is non-conversion eligible.
· Please list your anticipated graduation date (in MM/YY) and any relevant technical skills on your resume.
About Alstom:
Alstom is a leader in the mobility sector, tackling the most challenging problems for the future of transportation. Our Student Researcher Program fosters academic collaborations by enabling students to engage in meaningful research at Alstom. We value inquisitive and innovative individuals passionate about ensuring the safety and reliability of mobility systems.
At Alstom, we are building an agile, inclusive, and responsible culture. We offer diverse opportunities for learning and growth across various functions and geographic locations.
Equal Opportunity Statement:
Alstom is an equal opportunity employer committed to creating an inclusive working environment where all employees are encouraged to reach their full potential. We value and respect individual differences. All qualified applicants will be considered for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, national origin, disability status, or any other characteristic protected by local law.
